definition.product: Microsoft C 6.00AX (DOS-extended CL /EM: C1L, C2L, C3L), archive.org Microsoft_c_60ax disk 8
definition.note: Provenance C:/tools/msc-6.00ax-archive/provenance.json (disk images sha1/md5 = archive.org files.xml). No C4203 limit (global optimiser runs extended); ordinary modules give byte-identical objects to msc600a (worker ax: root 0093, 10F7, S25).
definition.include_note: Headers expanded (SZ/DECOMP-compatible expander, work/rt/unsz.py) from the verified 6.00A retail disk images of archive.org Microsoft_c_60ax (extracted/DISK*/INCLUDE); all 55 byte-identical to the previously used msc-6.00a-simantw/INCLUDE (2026-09-30).

semantic_gates.reason: Styled text and menu item classification sign-extend character bytes before indexing the near CRT table. Bytes D1..DE can read original DGROUP:79F0..79FD through _ctype+1 without any literal 79F0 operand. The stock runtime table owns its 257 bytes, not the preceding memory. The styled-text predicate can change the copied buffer and its text-resource match. Other dialog/menu sites also read outside the table; result relevance is assessed separately. No source guard or accepted input-domain proof excludes these prefix reads, and independent linkage does not preserve the original prefix. Keep the heap-shaped data debt; do not substitute unsigned indexing or add an invented table prefix/suffix. Whole-member controls on both linkers realize __fheap at _ctype-46, but identical data order still leaves six relocated CMISC pointers in the signed prefix: moving only crt0fp code changes twelve predicate results. Stock startup also changes heap descriptor pointers before main; original __myalloc binds the game allocator 171C:2208. App heap-state equivalence remains unproved, so relative owner attribution alone discharges no bytes.
semantic_gates.scope_limit: Conditional input path, not a shipped-resource execution witness. The reconstructed algorithms and strict static registrations remain unchanged.

semantic_gates.reason: The command-line parser accepts /s9, but detector/setup/cleanup tables have only nine entries (0..8). If the sound DB open returns, detector index 9 reads the adjacent same-TU saved-state pointer and calls its source-owned data as code. Return and effects are unproved. Conditional later setup/cleanup overreads include cross-TU data adjacency. Complete saved-state storage does not resolve this executable/layout dependency; no clamp, extra slot or padding is introduced.

The clip sentinel/generation count controls a copy to FAR_BSS 50F6:3C14. Large counts can intersect the historical graphics table addresses. Initial-state recipes do not prove those counts unreachable or preserve such physical overlap under an independent layout. Punt return and sentinel-copy bounds remain unresolved.

ZapEuMapAt and InvalEuMap bound writes against runtime viewport dimensions, rather than the thirty-row/forty-column storage extent. Dimensions derive from object 4 rectangles; resize and loaded window offsets are not yet proved to enforce that grid bound. A baseline resource rectangle in range does not prove all reachable writes or preserve cross-object overreads under a new layout.

Menu title-length and x-position arrays are written until a resource title sentinel, with no established capacity or title-count cap. Original word indices 10 and 20 respectively reach the separately owned render-delay word. Further words reach the bitmap Handle slot. The scalar owner does not prove those writes unreachable or preserve their cross-object effects under an independent layout. Minimum Handle slot ownership likewise does not resolve widths[11..12] or xpos[21..22] writes into its low/high words.

GetFreeHandle returns -1 when four slots are occupied. OpenDB calls Punt and then computes the record address if it returns. A four-record typed owner supplies no preceding storage; returning-Punt reachability and layout semantics must be proved separately. A bounded graphics-index failure executes the real 25-slot callback reset and the genuine empty callback, then reaches the uninitialized zero-height raster loop; its first glyph visits all 65536 DGROUP offsets before cleanup. This removes the hypothetical null-callback-return premise for that failure prefix, but proves neither eventual continuation nor an actual minus-one/fifth-record access. No global fatal-state invariance or noreturn waiver follows.

A returning failed OpenDB can be stored at db_handles[4] before the front end checks the negative result. The original address overlaps the distinct fd_50F6_3B58 object. No fifth slot, padding or noreturn assumption is introduced; this remains a separate source-only preflight gate.

Unconditional reset spans prove 45 callbacks and 45 Rects. They do not bound every window ID or resource count. Negative and >=45 indices, returning Punt, pre-lock handle writes, signed palette-copy lengths, and purge-list counts remain open. Historical palette row 63 reads hook31/hook32 words; its shipped control lacks the ordinary selection gate, but no complete selection/redraw or cross-owner exclusion exists. Callback45 intersects Rect0 and Rect45 intersects Event fields. No padding, invented palette rows, clamp or maximum historical capacity is supplied by the minimum owners.

The exact consumer and genuine CRT prove a minimal signed-byte view and startup zero. Window-pointer[-10] and a conditional uncapped song word-store continuation can cover the historical byte. No ordinary symbolic inbound selector edge exists, but computed/control-corrupted continuations and returning Punt are not globally excluded. Independent placement does not preserve those aliases. No constant-zero, dead-read or physical-alias waiver follows from the byte owner.

semantic_gates.owner: fd_50F6_46D2 minimum four-byte mutable Handle slot
semantic_gates.reason: Original pointer-chain reads, unchanged complete consumer TU and real RTLink/CRT controls authorize only the slot view and initial null representation. There is no known nominal game producer or observed ordinary incoming consumer edge. Computed writers/readers, indirect or control-corrupted activation and original physical aliases are not globally excluded. Independent placement does not preserve them. No deadness, permanent zero or safe null dereference follows from slot ownership.

semantic_gates.mandatory_if: Either icon helper reaches its pointer-load branch
semantic_gates.reason: The slot must designate a live four-byte far-pointer cell with a live byte payload covering the selected n and all renderer row accesses, or the corresponding activation must be independently excluded. The minimum slot provider creates neither referent. Producer/resource/allocator/lock/unhook identity, n bounds and payload capacity remain unproved.
